topic: Want high-end video ads but don't have the budget for a camera crew?

hooks.text: Myth: Only big budgets create motion; Fact: One phone photo does it.
Try this: Turn a single snapshot into a pro‑grade animated ad.

𝗡𝗢 𝗕𝗨𝗗𝗚𝗘𝗧 for a video shoot? A single clear photo from your phone can turn into a subtle, scrolling-stopping animated ad for your business.

Plans start at INR 999, pay only after you approve. DM ADS to see what fits.

replies.reply: Pricing is INR 999, 1,499, or 2,199 depending on the complexity and duration, and you pay only after you approve the work. Quick question: what do you sell, and are you planning to run this as a paid ad or a regular post?

replies.if_they_say: Do you do this for my kind of business?
replies.reply: Yes, it works well across various businesses like clinics, retail shops, or cafés where a clear photo of your space or product can be given motion. What does your business sell, and do you already have a photo to start with?

replies.if_they_say: Will AI make it look fake?
replies.reply: Fair question. I keep the motion subtle and realistic—clean depth, lighting shifts, and text transitions—rather than distorted effects. What kind of product or service do you want to feature?

image.prompt: Cinematic, moody wooden desk scene in a dark room featuring a warm gold lamp glow and a laptop displaying a visual animation timeline on a softly glowing screen. Beside the laptop, a smartphone displays a vibrant, high-end animated video. Rich shadows create a high-contrast look, with a wide, calm, dark space occupying the lower portion of the frame. Ultra-sharp 4K resolution, highly detailed, crisp focus, clean edges, cinematic lighting with soft glow, rich contrast, high dynamic range, premium polished finish, vertical 4:5 composition.
